Seasonal care tips for Chollas View

  • Change your HVAC filter every 1 to 3 months. If you live near SR 94 or have pets, monthly changes often make sense.
  • Keep supply and return vents open and clear by a few inches.
  • Trim back dust collecting items near returns like plush rugs or heavy drapes.
  • Spray off the outdoor AC coil with a garden hose from the inside out after pollen season. Power washers are too strong.
  • Check your dryer vent hood flap. If it sticks or is clogged, schedule a cleaning.
  • If you smell musty odors when it rains, ask about Duct Sanitizing or Residential HVAC Air Duct Disinfecting.

Why duct sealing pays off in our area

Leaky ducts pull hot attic air into the system and push cooled air into the attic instead of the rooms. That is wasted energy and uneven comfort.

Sealing can often

  • Reduce dust pulled from the attic
  • Help your AC cycle less during the hottest hours

Pair sealing with Duct Leakage Testing and Airflow Balancing for a stronger result.
